title: The Painted Verdict
author: Emrys Brightwater
blurb: Xanthe Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
